from AlgorithmImports import *
import math


class ExactStrategy(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.SetWarmUp(101, Resolution.Daily)

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_spy_values_valid = False

    def OnData(self, data):
        available_bars = {}

        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                available_bars[symbol] = data.Bars[symbol]

        if self.spy in available_bars:
            spy_bar = available_bars[self.spy]
            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)

        if self.aapl in available_bars:
            aapl_bar = available_bars[self.aapl]
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

        all_bars_present = all(symbol in available_bars for symbol in self.symbols)

        if not all_bars_present:
            self.previous_spy_values_valid = False
            return

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            self._update_previous_spy_values(available_bars[self.spy])
            return

        spy_bar = available_bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = available_bars[self.aapl]

        spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
        spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
        aapl_rsi = float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value)

        strategy_a_sell = (
            self.strategy_a_lot > 0
            and self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_values_valid
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close < spy_sma
        )

        strategy_b_sell = (
            self.strategy_b_lot > 0
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and aapl_rsi > 60
        )

        if strategy_a_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if strategy_b_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        strategy_a_buy = (
            self.strategy_a_lot == 0
            and self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_values_valid
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > spy_sma
        )

        if strategy_a_buy:
            target_value = 0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)
            quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / spy_close))

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        strategy_b_buy = (
            self.strategy_b_lot == 0
            and float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20000
        )

        if strategy_b_buy:
            quantity = int(math.floor(20000 / float(aapl_bar.Close)))

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        self._update_previous_spy_values(spy_bar)

    def _update_previous_spy_values(self, spy_bar):
        if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            self.previous_spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
            self.previous_spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
            self.previous_spy_values_valid = True
        else:
            self.previous_spy_values_valid = False

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.previous_aapl_close = None

        else:
            current_spy_sma = None

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        all_bars_present = all(
            symbol in data.Bars
            for symbol in [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]
        )

        if (
            not self.IsWarmingUp
            and all_bars_present
            and spy_bar is not None
            and aapl_bar is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and current_spy_sma is not None
            and self.rsi.IsReady
        ):
            spy_crosses_above = (
                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_bar.Close > current_spy_sma
            )

            spy_crosses_below = (
                self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_bar.Close < current_spy_sma
            )

            aapl_sell_reason = self.rsi.Current.Value > 60
            aapl_buy_reason = self.aapl_red_streak >= 3

            if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and aapl_sell_reason:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                self.strategy_b_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
                quantity = int(
                    math.floor(
                        0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue / spy_bar.Close
                    )
                )
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

            if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and aapl_buy_reason:
                if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                    quantity = int(math.floor(20000 / aapl_bar.Close))
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                        self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        if spy_bar is not None:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

from AlgorithmImports import *
from collections import deque
import math


class ExactStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=101)
        self.aapl_closes = deque(maxlen=4)

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.pending_a = 0
        self.pending_b = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        required = set(self.symbols.values())
        if not required.issubset(set(data.Bars.Keys)):
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
        previous_aapl_close = self.aapl_closes[-1] if self.aapl_closes else None

        self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)
        self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

        spy_cross_above = (
            previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and self.spy_closes
            and self.spy_closes[-1] <= previous_spy_sma
            and spy_bar.Close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        )

        spy_cross_below = (
            previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and self.spy_closes
            and self.spy_closes[-1] >= previous_spy_sma
            and spy_bar.Close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        )

        aapl_red_three_days = (
            len(self.aapl_closes) >= 3
            and aapl_bar.Close < self.aapl_closes[-1]
            and self.aapl_closes[-1] < self.aapl_closes[-2]
            and self.aapl_closes[-2] < self.aapl_closes[-3]
        )

        aapl_rsi_sell = (
            self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60
        )

        # Evaluate sells before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_cross_below:
            self.LiquidateLot(self.spy, "A")
            self.pending_a = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and aapl_rsi_sell:
            self.LiquidateLot(self.aapl, "B")
            self.pending_b = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and self.pending_a == 0 and spy_cross_above:
            quantity = int(
                math.floor(
                    (0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)
                    / spy_bar.Close
                )
            )
            if quantity > 0:
                self.pending_a = quantity
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity, tag="Strategy A buy")

        if (
            self.strategy_b_lot == 0
            and self.pending_b == 0
            and aapl_red_three_days
        ):
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(math.floor(20000 / aapl_bar.Close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.pending_b = quantity
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity, tag="Strategy B buy")

        self.spy_closes.append(spy_bar.Close)
        self.aapl_closes.append(aapl_bar.Close)

    def LiquidateLot(self, symbol, strategy):
        quantity = self.strategy_a_lot if strategy == "A" else self.strategy_b_lot
        if quantity > 0:
            self.MarketOrder(symbol, -quantity, tag=f"Strategy {strategy} sell")

    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event: OrderEvent):
        if order_event.Status != OrderStatus.Filled:
            return

        symbol = order_event.Symbol
        fill_quantity = order_event.FillQuantity

        if symbol == self.spy:
            if fill_quantity > 0:
                self.strategy_a_lot += fill_quantity
                self.pending_a = max(0, self.pending_a - fill_quantity)
            elif fill_quantity < 0:
                self.strategy_a_lot = max(
                    0, self.strategy_a_lot - abs(fill_quantity)
                )
                if self.strategy_a_lot == 0:
                    self.pending_a = 0

        elif symbol == self.aapl:
            if fill_quantity > 0:
                self.strategy_b_lot += fill_quantity
                self.pending_b = max(0, self.pending_b - fill_quantity)
            elif fill_quantity < 0:
                self.strategy_b_lot = max(
                    0, self.strategy_b_lot - abs(fill_quantity)
                )
                if self.strategy_b_lot == 0:
                    self.pending_b = 0

        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        spy_close = spy_bar.Close
        aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

        current_spy_sma = (
            self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
        )

        self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma
        self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_close)
        self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_close)

        if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
            if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        if self.IsWarmingUp:

        current_aapl_rsi = self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value
